en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father and all of my scholars narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Ḥusain ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Abī ‘Uthmān, from Muḥammad ibn Fuďayl, from Isḥāq ibn ‘Ammār, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The space between the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) and the heavens is (always) filled with angels who are descending and ascending (back and forth from the Ziyārah).
